statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let P := fun (d M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (E ((d:ℝ)*t))^(j+1); let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n d M : ℕ, 0<n → 0<d → d ≤ Q n → m (arcs n)ᶜ (fun t => ‖P d M t‖^2) ≤ 2*Real.pi*(n:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 所有小模数的等差指数和共享一个次弧能量上界
plain_statement.en: Uniform minor-arc leakage for every short denominator

brief.zh: 长度 M 任意，1≤d≤Q。取最邻近的 k/d 并约分；将几何和尾部积分，常数与 d、M 无关。
brief.en: For any length and 1≤d≤Q, reduce the nearest fraction k/d and integrate a geometric-sum tail. The constant is independent of d and M.
